description: Navigate a browser session to a URL (no model involved); starts the session if it is not running. learn and headed apply only when this call starts the session: learn=true records every later do/assert as a reusable flow step (needed before save_flow). Typical authoring: open (learn) → set_var → do/assert per outcome → save_flow → build_start.

cwd.description: Project directory (absolute) the command runs in; sitelooper.config.json is found from here. Default: the server's working directory.

headed.description: Show the browser window (--headed). Only takes effect when the session starts.

learn.description: Record a flow in this session (--learn). Only takes effect when the session starts.

session.description: Browser session name (default "default"). Each session is its own browser and daemon.

name: open
